answer: Chartered compliance officer audit log with financial conduct certification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 15 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 11685 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One ocean of signal, one inlet of cost, one oasis of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
